description:
## Problem
Previously quoted SF 1 data-generation timings (e.g., h2odb, tsbs_devops, vector_search, coffeeshop, joinorder_synthetic, amplab) have no recorded provenance, and docs/internal/adr/adr-python-core-runtime.md requires a measured throughput or memory wall before optimizing or introducing a native generator package.

## Change
- Measure every in-scope generator at SF 1 and SF 10 (noting any SF 10 run stopped by a time or memory cap): tpch, tpcds, ssb, h2odb, tsbs_devops (all 5 tables: tags, cpu, mem, disk, net), vector_search, coffeeshop, amplab, clickbench (synthetic mode), joinorder_synthetic, and tpch_skew.
- Record generation wall time, delimited-to-Parquet conversion wall time (BaseFormatConverter), total wall time, output bytes, and peak RSS separately using benchbox.utils.clock.mono_time() and OS peak RSS (ru_maxrss or /usr/bin/time -l).
- Record exact commands, host hardware/OS, and software versions so Phase 0 budgets are reproducible.

## Decision gates
- Identifies the single slowest/highest-RSS non-TPC synthetic generator to prototype in datagen-p0-vectorization-prototype.
- Supplies the empirical baselines from which datagen-p0-companion-adr sets per-benchmark wall-time and peak-RSS budgets.
- Stop and report if host memory pressure or heavy-lock contention prevents clean quiet-host measurement; never synthesize or reuse unsourced numbers.

## Guardrails
- Heavy work runs exclusively via make heavy-run after checking make heavy-status ([HEAVY-LOCK-001]). Announce command, max runtime, log path, and stop condition; never bypass the lock or watchdog.
- Write generated files only to an isolated temporary root and delete them afterwards; never mutate shared datagen/ folders ([RUN-DATA-001]).
- Read-only measurement task: change zero tracked repository code or existing benchmark data.
